create_calminereader: create a CalamineReader instance to read xlsx, xls, xlsb, or ods Excel files
load_workbook_excel: load an Excel workbook using the CalamineReader engine with optional engine kwargs
get_sheet_names: get a list of worksheet names from a loaded Calamine workbook
get_sheet_by_name: retrieve a specific CalamineSheet by its name from the workbook
get_sheet_data: extract sheet data as a list of rows with cell values converted to Python scalars
